title: Cells of a doubled code bit
statement: For Boolean words $\alpha,x$ and a natural number $j<|\alpha|$, the bits at positions $2j$ and $2j+1$ in the pair encoding $\langle\alpha,x\rangle$ both equal $\alpha_j$.
replaced:
For every $j < |\alpha|$, cells $2j$ and $2j+1$ of the pair encoding
$\langle \alpha, x\rangle$ both hold the code bit $\alpha_j$.
